table ip crowdsec {
	set crowdsec-blacklists-crowdsec {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags timeout
		elements = { 192.0.2.10 timeout 4h,
			     192.0.2.11 timeout 2h }
	}

	chain crowdsec-chain {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		ip saddr @crowdsec-blacklists-crowdsec drop
	}
}
table inet host {
	set dyn {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1h
		elements = { 192.0.2.20 }
	}

	set ports {
		type inet_service
		elements = { 22, 443 }
	}

	chain in {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		tcp dport @ports ct state new add @dyn { ip saddr }
	}
}
